scholarships.title: Fellowship for International Research Scholars in Technology at IIT Hyderabad (FIRST@IITH)

eligibility: Foreign national, explicitly excluding OCI and NRI candidates
Master's degree in a relevant engineering or technology discipline
Minimum CGPA of 8.5 out of 10 or equivalent for the July 2026 intake; the January 2026 intake page stated a minimum CGPA of 8.0
Both the bachelor's and the master's degrees must be obtained from foreign universities
existing.eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals, excluding OCI and NRI candidates, with excellent academic credentials, holding a master's degree in a relevant engineering or technology discipline with a minimum CGPA of 8.5 out of 10 or equivalent for the July 2026 intake. Both the bachelor's and the master's degrees must have been obtained from foreign universities.
benefits: Annual contingency support of INR 1,00,000 for research expenses such as conference travel or specialised materials
Full financial support across the four-year doctoral programme
coverage: Full financial support for the four-year doctoral programme
requirements: Use the intake-specific application form, for example FIRST_APPLICATION_July-2026.pdf
Send the completed form with electronic copies of the testimonials and one reference letter by email
Use the exact intake-specific subject line on the email
existing.english_requirement: The application materials are published by IIT Hyderabad in English, and academic transcripts are expected in English.
application_method: Download the intake-specific application form from the IIT Hyderabad International Relations site
Email the form with the testimonials and one reference letter to ia.ir@iith.ac.in with the subject line "Application for FIRST@IITH fellowship - July-2026" for that intake
Alternatively consult the FIRST@IITH information document for programme detail
existing.selection_notes: Selection follows a shortlisting stage and then an online interview. The institute places value on research output, so candidates with peer-reviewed publications or patent disclosures are at an advantage. Degrees from leading universities in the candidate's home country are treated as a desirable qualification.
existing.best_fit: Foreign nationals with a master's in engineering or technology and a CGPA of at least 8.5, whose bachelor's and master's degrees are both from foreign universities, seeking a fully funded four-year PhD at IIT Hyderabad.
existing.notes: The scheme is explicitly restricted to foreign nationals and excludes OCI and NRI candidates, unlike IIT Hyderabad's self-financing PhD route which is open to all foreign nationals including OCI and NRI. The stated minimum CGPA has varied between intakes, 8.0 on the January 2026 page and 8.5 on the July 2026 page, so applicants should check the figure for the intake they are applying to.
existing.application_period: Two intakes a year, January and July. The January intake closes in early November and the July intake closes at the end of April.
existing.deadline_display: Official FIRST@IITH deadlines are intake-specific. For the January 2026 intake the page states "The application deadline was 07-November-2025 17:00 hrs IST". For the July 2026 intake it states "The last date to send the application by email is 30-April-2026, 17:00 hrs IST". Both have passed and no next-intake deadline has been published.
existing.program_type: Fully funded doctoral fellowship for international research scholars

existing.description: The Ramanujan Fellowship, operated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, is a reverse brain drain scheme that brings brilliant Indian and Indian-origin scientists and engineers from abroad to take up scientific research positions in India. It is scientist-specific and highly selective, restricted to candidates below 40 years of age who hold a higher degree such as a PhD in science or engineering, a master's in engineering or technology, or an MD, with adequate professional experience and a proven track record evidenced by publications and recognition. Fellows must not already hold any permanent, tenure-track or contractual position in an Indian institution or university, and must be working abroad at the time of nomination. The fellowship pays Rs 1,35,000 per month consolidated including HRA, plus a research grant of Rs 7.00 lakh per annum and Rs 60,000 per annum in overhead charges to the host institute.
eligibility: Be a brilliant Indian or Indian-origin scientist or engineer from abroad
Hold a higher degree or equivalent, such as a PhD in Science or Engineering, a Master's in Engineering or Technology, or an MD in Medicine, and have adequate professional experience
Have a proven outstanding track record evidenced by research publications and recognitions
Be working abroad at the time of nomination
Not hold any permanent, tenure-track or contractual position in any Indian institute or university
Not already hold a Ramanujan Fellowship
existing.eligibility_summary: Brilliant Indian or Indian-origin scientists and engineers working abroad, below 40 years of age, holding a higher degree such as a PhD in science or engineering, a master's in engineering or technology, or an MD, with adequate professional experience and a proven outstanding publication and recognition record, and not holding any permanent, tenure-track or contractual position in an Indian institute or university.
benefits: Consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs 1,35,000 including HRA
Annual research grant of Rs 7.00 lakh to the host institute
Annual overhead charges of Rs 60,000 to the host institute
Eligibility to apply for regular extramural research grants through Government of India S&T agencies
Travel and daily allowance entitlement equivalent to Scientist-D for TA/DA
coverage: Fellowship of Rs 1,35,000 per month, consolidated including HRA
Research grant of Rs 7.00 lakh per annum for consumables, travel, research personnel and contingencies
Overhead charges of Rs 60,000 per annum to the host institute
Eligibility to receive regular extramural research grants through Government of India S&T agency schemes
requirements: Register on the ANRF portal and complete all mandatory profile fields
Be nominated by the head of the host organisation, university or institute in India (or an authorised official)
Nominations from the candidate's PhD supervisors or from the institute where the PhD was pursued will not be considered
Upload the research proposal as a single PDF of no more than 5 pages
Join the host institute within six months of the selection intimation letter, or the award is cancelled
documents: Nomination Letter on letterhead, duly signed and stamped (official NML_RJF template)
Proposed area of research and brief outline of proposal in a single PDF of no more than 5 pages
existing.english_requirement: Local Chapters of the Society if not registered separately should submit their application only through their registered body. (Grants, if approved, will be released only in favor of main Society).
application_method: Register on the ANRF online portal at www.anrfonline.in
Fill all mandatory fields in the Profile Details section, including photo, institution and address
Under Form Submission choose Scheme: Ramanujan Fellowship and complete the nomination form
Upload the proposed area of research and a brief outline of the proposal in a single PDF of no more than 5 pages
The nominator receives an email with a link to review and either submit the nomination to ANRF or return it for revision
existing.selection_notes: Selection is made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee specially appointed for the purpose. Candidates approach the institution of their choice for hosting and the institution forwards the nomination to ANRF.
existing.best_fit: Brilliant Indian or Indian-origin scientists and engineers under 40, currently working abroad, with a strong publication record and no Indian institutional position, seeking to return to India for up to five years.
existing.application_period: Continuous. Nominees register on the ANRF portal, fill the Ramanujan Fellowship nomination form and send it to their nominator at the host institution, who verifies and submits it to ANRF. Selection is made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee.
existing.deadline_display: No fixed application deadline is published; nominations are submitted year-round through the ANRF online portal and selections are made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee.
